questions.stem: Who appoints the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
questions.explain: The President of India appoints the Chief Election Commissioner.

questions.stem: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was rolled out nationwide in India in which year?
questions.explain: GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

If all roses are flowers and some flowers fade quickly, which statement must be true?
choices: Some flowers may or may not be roses
